ingredientSections.heading: Crab Salad
items: ½ Red Pepper, roasted, skin and seeds removed
½ Cup Fresh Cooked Corn on the Cob, cut off the cob

ingredientSections.heading: Cherry Tomato & Corn Salsa
items: 1 Ear of Corn, cut off the cob and diced
¼ Cup Red Onions, diced finely
½ Red Pepper, roasted, skin and seeds removed

methodSections.heading: Aji Amarillo Causa
steps: Peel the potatoes, put in a pot and fill with cold water. Bring to the boil and cook until soft.
Drain the potatoes very well. Make sure all water is gone. If still wet put on a tray in the oven for a few minutes to dry out.
Rice the potatoes, or mash until very smooth.
Add lime juice, aji amarillo paste and then oil. Taste and adjust seasoning and then allow to cool.

methodSections.heading: Crab Salad
steps: Add all ingredients and taste, adjust seasoning and chill.

methodSections.heading: Cherry Tomato & Corn Salsa
steps: Add all ingredients and taste, adjust seasoning and chill.

methodSections.heading: Assembly
steps: With a 8cm ring mould layer first the potato mixture then the crab mix until the mould is half full.
Add a piece of avocado and then fill the mould with more potato.
Remove the mould and add the cherry tomato salsa on top and garnish with fresh mint.
